# Core ContainerDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/core.container_diagram.md

# Core ContainerDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [core.container-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/core.container-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [ContainerDiagram][c4.diagrams.container.ContainerDiagram] spec for the Core backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `ContainerDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/core/container-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/core/container-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```


### Elements

- [PersonSchema](#personschema)
- [PersonExtSchema](#personextschema)
- [SystemSchema](#systemschema)
- [SystemExtSchema](#systemextschema)
- [SystemDbSchema](#systemdbschema)
- [SystemDbExtSchema](#systemdbextschema)
- [SystemQueueSchema](#systemqueueschema)
- [SystemQueueExtSchema](#systemqueueextschema)
- [ContainerSchema](#containerschema)
- [ContainerExtSchema](#containerextschema)
- [ContainerDbSchema](#containerdbschema)
- [ContainerDbExtSchema](#containerdbextschema)
- [ContainerQueueSchema](#containerqueueschema)
- [ContainerQueueExtSchema](#containerqueueextschema)

- [BoundarySchema](#boundaryschema)
- [EnterpriseBoundarySchema](#enterpriseboundaryschema)
- [SystemBoundarySchema](#systemboundaryschema)
- [ContainerBoundarySchema](#containerboundaryschema)

### Relationships

- [RelationshipSchema](#relationshipschema)

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### BoundarySchema

This schema describes the
[`Boundary`][c4.diagrams.core.Boundary]
diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `Boundary`. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Elements may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Boundaries may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Relationships declared inside the boundary. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

diagram component.

    |---|---|---|

This schema describes the [`Relationship`][c4.diagrams.core.Relationship]
diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the relationship. Must be exactly `REL`. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Additional details about the relationship. |
    | **`from(required)`** | `string` | The source element alias (or unique label). |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | The label shown on the relationship edge. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | The technology used in the communication. |
    | **`to(required)`** | `string` | The destination element alias (or unique label). |

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |

    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Elements may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Boundaries may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Relationships declared inside the boundary. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |

# Core DeploymentDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/core.deployment_diagram.md

# Core DeploymentDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [core.deployment-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/core.deployment-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [DeploymentDiagram][c4.diagrams.deployment.DeploymentDiagram] spec for the Core backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `DeploymentDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/core/deployment-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/core/deployment-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```


### Elements

- [PersonSchema](#personschema)
- [PersonExtSchema](#personextschema)
- [SystemSchema](#systemschema)
- [SystemExtSchema](#systemextschema)
- [SystemDbSchema](#systemdbschema)
- [SystemDbExtSchema](#systemdbextschema)
- [SystemQueueSchema](#systemqueueschema)
- [SystemQueueExtSchema](#systemqueueextschema)
- [ContainerSchema](#containerschema)
- [ContainerExtSchema](#containerextschema)
- [ContainerDbSchema](#containerdbschema)
- [ContainerDbExtSchema](#containerdbextschema)
- [ContainerQueueSchema](#containerqueueschema)
- [ContainerQueueExtSchema](#containerqueueextschema)

### Boundaries

- [NodeSchema](#nodeschema)
- [DeploymentNodeSchema](#deploymentnodeschema)

### Relationships

- [RelationshipSchema](#relationshipschema)

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

This schema describes the
[`ContainerDbExt`][c4.diagrams.container.ContainerDbExt]
diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `ContainerDbExt`. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional technology. |

### DiagramElementPropertiesSchema

JSON schema for tabular diagram element properties.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `header` | <code>array[string]</code> | Header columns. Default: `["Property", "Value"]`. |
    | **`properties(required)`** | <code>array[array[string]]</code> | List of rows (each row is a list of string values). |
    | `show_header` | `boolean` | Whether to display the header row. Default: `true`. |

    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

---

# Core DynamicDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/core.dynamic_diagram.md

# Core DynamicDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [core.dynamic-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/core.dynamic-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [DynamicDiagram][c4.diagrams.dynamic.DynamicDiagram] spec for the Core backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `DynamicDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Relationships declared inside the boundary. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/core/dynamic-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/core/dynamic-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### ComponentDbExtSchema

This schema describes the
[`ComponentDbExt`][c4.diagrams.component.ComponentDbExt]
diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `ComponentDbExt`. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional technology. |

### DiagramElementPropertiesSchema

JSON schema for tabular diagram element properties.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `header` | <code>array[string]</code> | Header columns. Default: `["Property", "Value"]`. |
    | **`properties(required)`** | <code>array[array[string]]</code> | List of rows (each row is a list of string values). |
    | `show_header` | `boolean` | Whether to display the header row. Default: `true`. |

    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Boundaries may be nested arbitrarily. |

This schema describes the [`Relationship`][c4.diagrams.core.Relationship]
diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the relationship. Must be exactly `REL`. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Additional details about the relationship. |
    | **`from(required)`** | `string` | The source element alias (or unique label). |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | The label shown on the relationship edge. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | The technology used in the communication. |
    | **`to(required)`** | `string` | The destination element alias (or unique label). |

    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `SystemQueue`. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

### SystemSchema

[`System`][c4.diagrams.system_context.System] diagram component.

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    |---|---|---|

# Core SystemContextDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [core.system-context-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/core.system-context-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [SystemContextDiagram][c4.diagrams.system_context.SystemContextDiagram] spec for the Core backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `SystemContextDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/core/system-context-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/core/system-context-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```


### Elements

- [PersonSchema](#personschema)
- [PersonExtSchema](#personextschema)
- [SystemSchema](#systemschema)
- [SystemExtSchema](#systemextschema)
- [SystemDbSchema](#systemdbschema)
- [SystemDbExtSchema](#systemdbextschema)
- [SystemQueueSchema](#systemqueueschema)
- [SystemQueueExtSchema](#systemqueueextschema)

### Boundaries

- [BoundarySchema](#boundaryschema)
- [EnterpriseBoundarySchema](#enterpriseboundaryschema)
- [SystemBoundarySchema](#systemboundaryschema)

### Relationships

- [RelationshipSchema](#relationshipschema)

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### BoundarySchema

This schema describes the
[`Boundary`][c4.diagrams.core.Boundary]
diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `Boundary`. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Elements may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Boundaries may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Relationships declared inside the boundary. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

### DiagramElementPropertiesSchema

JSON schema for tabular diagram element properties.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `header` | <code>array[string]</code> | Header columns. Default: `["Property", "Value"]`. |
    | **`properties(required)`** | <code>array[array[string]]</code> | List of rows (each row is a list of string values). |
    | `show_header` | `boolean` | Whether to display the header row. Default: `true`. |

### EnterpriseBoundarySchema

This schema describes the

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Boundaries may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Relationships declared inside the boundary. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

# Mermaid ComponentDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/mermaid.component_diagram.md

# Mermaid ComponentDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [mermaid.component-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/mermaid.component-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [ComponentDiagram][c4.diagrams.component.ComponentDiagram] spec for the Mermaid backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `ComponentDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#mermaidrelationshipschema">MermaidRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |
    | `render_options` | <code><a href="#mermaidrenderoptionsschema">MermaidRenderOptionsSchema</a></code> | Mermaid-specific render options. |
    | **`backend(required)`** | `string` | JSON schema backend. Must be exactly `mermaid`. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/component-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/component-diagram.minimal.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![ComponentDiagram minimal example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/component-diagram.minimal.png)
            </figure>


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/component-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/component-diagram.advanced.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![ComponentDiagram advanced example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/component-diagram.advanced.png)
            </figure>

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### RelationshipType

Relationship types supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Items"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Type | Description |
    |---|---|
    | `BI_REL` | A bidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL` | A unidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL_BACK` | A unidirectional relationship pointing backward. |
    | `REL_D` | A unidirectional downward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_DOWN`. |
    | `REL_DOWN` | A unidirectional downward relationship. |
    | `REL_L` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_LEFT`. |
    | `REL_LEFT` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. |
    | `REL_R` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_RIGHT`. |
    | `REL_RIGHT` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. |
    | `REL_U` | A unidirectional upward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_UP`. |
    | `REL_UP` | A unidirectional upward relationship. |

### BoundarySchema

This schema describes the
[`Boundary`][c4.diagrams.core.Boundary]
diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `Boundary`. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Elements may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Boundaries may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Relationships declared inside the boundary. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

### DiagramElementPropertiesSchema

JSON schema for tabular diagram element properties.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `header` | <code>array[string]</code> | Header columns. Default: `["Property", "Value"]`. |
    | **`properties(required)`** | <code>array[array[string]]</code> | List of rows (each row is a list of string values). |
    | `show_header` | `boolean` | Whether to display the header row. Default: `true`. |

### MermaidRelationshipSchema

JSON schema for relationships supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | <code><a href="#relationshiptype">RelationshipType</a></code> | Type of the relationship. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Additional details about the relationship. |
    | **`from(required)`** | `string` | The source element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | The label shown on the relationship edge. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | The technology used in the communication. |
    | **`to(required)`** | `string` | The destination element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |

    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

### RelationshipSchema

This schema describes the [`Relationship`][c4.diagrams.core.Relationship]
diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the relationship. Must be exactly `REL`. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Additional details about the relationship. |
    | **`from(required)`** | `string` | The source element alias (or unique label). |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | The label shown on the relationship edge. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | The technology used in the communication. |
    | **`to(required)`** | `string` | The destination element alias (or unique label). |

## Mermaid Render Options


### MermaidRenderOptionsSchema

Final layout configuration for rendering a Mermaid C4 diagram.

Encapsulates layout directives, macros, tag definitions, and visual styles
applied at render time.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `styles` | <code>array[<code><a href="#mermaidelementstyleschema">MermaidElementStyleSchema</a></code>\|<code><a href="#mermaidrelstyleschema">MermaidRelStyleSchema</a></code>]</code> | List of style update macro configurations. |
    | `update_layout_config` | <code><a href="#updatelayoutconfigschema">UpdateLayoutConfigSchema</a></code> | Configuration for updating default layout behavior. |

### MermaidElementStyleSchema

Style update for an individual diagram element.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `ElementStyle`. |
    | `bg_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Background color. |
    | `border_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Border line color. |
    | **`element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the element to style. |
    | `font_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Font/text color. |

### MermaidRelStyleSchema

Style update for relationship lines.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `RelStyle`. |
    | **`from_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the source element to style. |
    | `line_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship line. |
    | `offset_x` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional horizontal offset for the label position. |
    | `offset_y` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional vertical offset for the label position. |
    | `text_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship label text. |
    | **`to_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the target element to style. |

### UpdateLayoutConfigSchema

Configuration for updating default layout behavior in
Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `c4_boundary_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of boundaries per row. |
    | `c4_shape_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of non-boundary elements (e.g. systems, containers, components) per row. |

# Mermaid ContainerDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/mermaid.container_diagram.md

# Mermaid ContainerDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [mermaid.container-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/mermaid.container-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [ContainerDiagram][c4.diagrams.container.ContainerDiagram] spec for the Mermaid backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `ContainerDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#mermaidrelationshipschema">MermaidRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |
    | `render_options` | <code><a href="#mermaidrenderoptionsschema">MermaidRenderOptionsSchema</a></code> | Mermaid-specific render options. |
    | **`backend(required)`** | `string` | JSON schema backend. Must be exactly `mermaid`. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/container-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/container-diagram.minimal.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![ContainerDiagram minimal example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/container-diagram.minimal.png)
            </figure>


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/container-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/container-diagram.advanced.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![ContainerDiagram advanced example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/container-diagram.advanced.png)
            </figure>

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### RelationshipType

Relationship types supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Items"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Type | Description |
    |---|---|
    | `BI_REL` | A bidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL` | A unidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL_BACK` | A unidirectional relationship pointing backward. |
    | `REL_D` | A unidirectional downward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_DOWN`. |
    | `REL_DOWN` | A unidirectional downward relationship. |
    | `REL_L` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_LEFT`. |
    | `REL_LEFT` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. |
    | `REL_R` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_RIGHT`. |
    | `REL_RIGHT` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. |
    | `REL_U` | A unidirectional upward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_UP`. |
    | `REL_UP` | A unidirectional upward relationship. |

### DiagramElementPropertiesSchema

JSON schema for tabular diagram element properties.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `header` | <code>array[string]</code> | Header columns. Default: `["Property", "Value"]`. |
    | **`properties(required)`** | <code>array[array[string]]</code> | List of rows (each row is a list of string values). |
    | `show_header` | `boolean` | Whether to display the header row. Default: `true`. |

### MermaidRelationshipSchema

JSON schema for relationships supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | <code><a href="#relationshiptype">RelationshipType</a></code> | Type of the relationship. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Additional details about the relationship. |
    | **`from(required)`** | `string` | The source element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | The label shown on the relationship edge. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | The technology used in the communication. |
    | **`to(required)`** | `string` | The destination element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |

### PersonExtSchema

This schema describes the
[`PersonExt`][c4.diagrams.system_context.PersonExt] diagram component.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|

    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

## Mermaid Render Options


### MermaidRenderOptionsSchema

Final layout configuration for rendering a Mermaid C4 diagram.

Encapsulates layout directives, macros, tag definitions, and visual styles
applied at render time.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `styles` | <code>array[<code><a href="#mermaidelementstyleschema">MermaidElementStyleSchema</a></code>\|<code><a href="#mermaidrelstyleschema">MermaidRelStyleSchema</a></code>]</code> | List of style update macro configurations. |
    | `update_layout_config` | <code><a href="#updatelayoutconfigschema">UpdateLayoutConfigSchema</a></code> | Configuration for updating default layout behavior. |

### MermaidElementStyleSchema

Style update for an individual diagram element.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `ElementStyle`. |
    | `bg_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Background color. |
    | `border_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Border line color. |
    | **`element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the element to style. |
    | `font_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Font/text color. |

### MermaidRelStyleSchema

Style update for relationship lines.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `RelStyle`. |
    | **`from_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the source element to style. |
    | `line_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship line. |
    | `offset_x` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional horizontal offset for the label position. |
    | `offset_y` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional vertical offset for the label position. |
    | `text_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship label text. |
    | **`to_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the target element to style. |

### UpdateLayoutConfigSchema

Configuration for updating default layout behavior in
Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `c4_boundary_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of boundaries per row. |
    | `c4_shape_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of non-boundary elements (e.g. systems, containers, components) per row. |

# Mermaid DeploymentDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/mermaid.deployment_diagram.md

# Mermaid DeploymentDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [mermaid.deployment-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/mermaid.deployment-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [DeploymentDiagram][c4.diagrams.deployment.DeploymentDiagram] spec for the Mermaid backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `DeploymentDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#mermaidrelationshipschema">MermaidRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |
    | `render_options` | <code><a href="#mermaidrenderoptionsschema">MermaidRenderOptionsSchema</a></code> | Mermaid-specific render options. |
    | **`backend(required)`** | `string` | JSON schema backend. Must be exactly `mermaid`. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/deployment-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/deployment-diagram.minimal.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![DeploymentDiagram minimal example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/deployment-diagram.minimal.png)
            </figure>


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/deployment-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/deployment-diagram.advanced.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![DeploymentDiagram advanced example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/deployment-diagram.advanced.png)
            </figure>

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### RelationshipType

Relationship types supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Items"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Type | Description |
    |---|---|
    | `BI_REL` | A bidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL` | A unidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL_BACK` | A unidirectional relationship pointing backward. |
    | `REL_D` | A unidirectional downward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_DOWN`. |
    | `REL_DOWN` | A unidirectional downward relationship. |
    | `REL_L` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_LEFT`. |
    | `REL_LEFT` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. |
    | `REL_R` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_RIGHT`. |
    | `REL_RIGHT` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. |
    | `REL_U` | A unidirectional upward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_UP`. |
    | `REL_UP` | A unidirectional upward relationship. |

### DiagramElementPropertiesSchema

JSON schema for tabular diagram element properties.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `header` | <code>array[string]</code> | Header columns. Default: `["Property", "Value"]`. |
    | **`properties(required)`** | <code>array[array[string]]</code> | List of rows (each row is a list of string values). |
    | `show_header` | `boolean` | Whether to display the header row. Default: `true`. |

### MermaidRelationshipSchema

JSON schema for relationships supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | <code><a href="#relationshiptype">RelationshipType</a></code> | Type of the relationship. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Additional details about the relationship. |
    | **`from(required)`** | `string` | The source element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | The label shown on the relationship edge. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | The technology used in the communication. |
    | **`to(required)`** | `string` | The destination element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |

    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#relationshipschema">RelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |

## Mermaid Render Options


### MermaidRenderOptionsSchema

Final layout configuration for rendering a Mermaid C4 diagram.

Encapsulates layout directives, macros, tag definitions, and visual styles
applied at render time.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `styles` | <code>array[<code><a href="#mermaidelementstyleschema">MermaidElementStyleSchema</a></code>\|<code><a href="#mermaidrelstyleschema">MermaidRelStyleSchema</a></code>]</code> | List of style update macro configurations. |
    | `update_layout_config` | <code><a href="#updatelayoutconfigschema">UpdateLayoutConfigSchema</a></code> | Configuration for updating default layout behavior. |

### MermaidElementStyleSchema

Style update for an individual diagram element.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `ElementStyle`. |
    | `bg_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Background color. |
    | `border_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Border line color. |
    | **`element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the element to style. |
    | `font_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Font/text color. |

### MermaidRelStyleSchema

Style update for relationship lines.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `RelStyle`. |
    | **`from_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the source element to style. |
    | `line_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship line. |
    | `offset_x` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional horizontal offset for the label position. |
    | `offset_y` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional vertical offset for the label position. |
    | `text_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship label text. |
    | **`to_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the target element to style. |

### UpdateLayoutConfigSchema

Configuration for updating default layout behavior in
Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `c4_boundary_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of boundaries per row. |
    | `c4_shape_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of non-boundary elements (e.g. systems, containers, components) per row. |

# Mermaid DynamicDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/mermaid.dynamic_diagram.md

# Mermaid DynamicDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [mermaid.dynamic-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/mermaid.dynamic-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [DynamicDiagram][c4.diagrams.dynamic.DynamicDiagram] spec for the Mermaid backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `DynamicDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#mermaidrelationshipschema">MermaidRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |
    | `render_options` | <code><a href="#mermaidrenderoptionsschema">MermaidRenderOptionsSchema</a></code> | Mermaid-specific render options. |
    | **`backend(required)`** | `string` | JSON schema backend. Must be exactly `mermaid`. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/dynamic-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/dynamic-diagram.minimal.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![DynamicDiagram minimal example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/dynamic-diagram.minimal.png)
            </figure>


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/dynamic-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/dynamic-diagram.advanced.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![DynamicDiagram advanced example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/dynamic-diagram.advanced.png)
            </figure>

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### RelationshipType

Relationship types supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Items"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Type | Description |
    |---|---|
    | `BI_REL` | A bidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL` | A unidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL_BACK` | A unidirectional relationship pointing backward. |
    | `REL_D` | A unidirectional downward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_DOWN`. |
    | `REL_DOWN` | A unidirectional downward relationship. |
    | `REL_L` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_LEFT`. |
    | `REL_LEFT` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. |
    | `REL_R` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_RIGHT`. |
    | `REL_RIGHT` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. |
    | `REL_U` | A unidirectional upward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_UP`. |
    | `REL_UP` | A unidirectional upward relationship. |

    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional technology. |

### MermaidRelationshipSchema

JSON schema for relationships supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | <code><a href="#relationshiptype">RelationshipType</a></code> | Type of the relationship. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Additional details about the relationship. |
    | **`from(required)`** | `string` | The source element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | The label shown on the relationship edge. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | The technology used in the communication. |
    | **`to(required)`** | `string` | The destination element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |

## Mermaid Render Options


### MermaidRenderOptionsSchema

Final layout configuration for rendering a Mermaid C4 diagram.

Encapsulates layout directives, macros, tag definitions, and visual styles
applied at render time.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `styles` | <code>array[<code><a href="#mermaidelementstyleschema">MermaidElementStyleSchema</a></code>\|<code><a href="#mermaidrelstyleschema">MermaidRelStyleSchema</a></code>]</code> | List of style update macro configurations. |
    | `update_layout_config` | <code><a href="#updatelayoutconfigschema">UpdateLayoutConfigSchema</a></code> | Configuration for updating default layout behavior. |

### MermaidElementStyleSchema

Style update for an individual diagram element.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `ElementStyle`. |
    | `bg_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Background color. |
    | `border_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Border line color. |
    | **`element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the element to style. |
    | `font_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Font/text color. |

### MermaidRelStyleSchema

Style update for relationship lines.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `RelStyle`. |
    | **`from_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the source element to style. |
    | `line_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship line. |
    | `offset_x` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional horizontal offset for the label position. |
    | `offset_y` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional vertical offset for the label position. |
    | `text_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship label text. |
    | **`to_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the target element to style. |

### UpdateLayoutConfigSchema

Configuration for updating default layout behavior in
Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `c4_boundary_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of boundaries per row. |
    | `c4_shape_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of non-boundary elements (e.g. systems, containers, components) per row. |

# Mermaid SystemContextDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/mermaid.system_context_diagram.md

# Mermaid SystemContextDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [mermaid.system-context-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/mermaid.system-context-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [SystemContextDiagram][c4.diagrams.system_context.SystemContextDiagram] spec for the Mermaid backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `SystemContextDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#mermaidrelationshipschema">MermaidRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |
    | `render_options` | <code><a href="#mermaidrenderoptionsschema">MermaidRenderOptionsSchema</a></code> | Mermaid-specific render options. |
    | **`backend(required)`** | `string` | JSON schema backend. Must be exactly `mermaid`. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/system-context-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/system-context-diagram.minimal.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![SystemContextDiagram minimal example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/system-context-diagram.minimal.png)
            </figure>


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/system-context-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/system-context-diagram.advanced.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![SystemContextDiagram advanced example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/system-context-diagram.advanced.png)
            </figure>

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### RelationshipType

Relationship types supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Items"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Type | Description |
    |---|---|
    | `BI_REL` | A bidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL` | A unidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL_BACK` | A unidirectional relationship pointing backward. |
    | `REL_D` | A unidirectional downward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_DOWN`. |
    | `REL_DOWN` | A unidirectional downward relationship. |
    | `REL_L` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_LEFT`. |
    | `REL_LEFT` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. |
    | `REL_R` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_RIGHT`. |
    | `REL_RIGHT` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. |
    | `REL_U` | A unidirectional upward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_UP`. |
    | `REL_UP` | A unidirectional upward relationship. |

### DiagramElementPropertiesSchema

JSON schema for tabular diagram element properties.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `header` | <code>array[string]</code> | Header columns. Default: `["Property", "Value"]`. |
    | **`properties(required)`** | <code>array[array[string]]</code> | List of rows (each row is a list of string values). |
    | `show_header` | `boolean` | Whether to display the header row. Default: `true`. |

### MermaidBoundarySchema

Mermaid JSON schema for a generic boundary.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `Boundary`. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Elements may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Boundaries may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#mermaidrelationshipschema">MermaidRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Relationships declared inside the boundary. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `stereotype` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional Mermaid boundary type/stereotype label. |

### MermaidEnterpriseBoundarySchema

Mermaid JSON schema for an enterprise boundary.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `EnterpriseBoundary`. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Elements may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Boundaries may be nested arbitrarily. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#mermaidrelationshipschema">MermaidRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Relationships declared inside the boundary. |
    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `stereotype` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional Mermaid boundary type/stereotype label. |

### MermaidRelationshipSchema

JSON schema for relationships supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | <code><a href="#relationshiptype">RelationshipType</a></code> | Type of the relationship. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Additional details about the relationship. |
    | **`from(required)`** | `string` | The source element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | The label shown on the relationship edge. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |
    | `technology` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | The technology used in the communication. |
    | **`to(required)`** | `string` | The destination element alias (or unique label). For Mermaid, this must resolve to a concrete element, not a boundary. |

## Mermaid Render Options


### MermaidRenderOptionsSchema

Final layout configuration for rendering a Mermaid C4 diagram.

Encapsulates layout directives, macros, tag definitions, and visual styles
applied at render time.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `styles` | <code>array[<code><a href="#mermaidelementstyleschema">MermaidElementStyleSchema</a></code>\|<code><a href="#mermaidrelstyleschema">MermaidRelStyleSchema</a></code>]</code> | List of style update macro configurations. |
    | `update_layout_config` | <code><a href="#updatelayoutconfigschema">UpdateLayoutConfigSchema</a></code> | Configuration for updating default layout behavior. |

### MermaidElementStyleSchema

Style update for an individual diagram element.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `ElementStyle`. |
    | `bg_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Background color. |
    | `border_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Border line color. |
    | **`element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the element to style. |
    | `font_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Font/text color. |

### MermaidRelStyleSchema

Style update for relationship lines.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `RelStyle`. |
    | **`from_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the source element to style. |
    | `line_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship line. |
    | `offset_x` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional horizontal offset for the label position. |
    | `offset_y` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional vertical offset for the label position. |
    | `text_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship label text. |
    | **`to_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the target element to style. |

### UpdateLayoutConfigSchema

Configuration for updating default layout behavior in
Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `c4_boundary_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of boundaries per row. |
    | `c4_shape_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of non-boundary elements (e.g. systems, containers, components) per row. |

# Mermaid SystemLandscapeDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/mermaid.system_landscape_diagram.md

# Mermaid SystemLandscapeDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [mermaid.system-landscape-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/mermaid.system-landscape-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [SystemLandscapeDiagram][c4.diagrams.system_context.SystemLandscapeDiagram] spec for the Mermaid backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `SystemLandscapeDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#mermaidrelationshipschema">MermaidRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |
    | `render_options` | <code><a href="#mermaidrenderoptionsschema">MermaidRenderOptionsSchema</a></code> | Mermaid-specific render options. |
    | **`backend(required)`** | `string` | JSON schema backend. Must be exactly `mermaid`. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/system-landscape-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/system-landscape-diagram.minimal.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![SystemLandscapeDiagram minimal example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/system-landscape-diagram.minimal.png)
            </figure>


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/mermaid/system-landscape-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered Mermaid source"

            ```mmd
            --8<-- "assets/examples/mermaid/system-landscape-diagram.advanced.mmd"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![SystemLandscapeDiagram advanced example](../../../assets/examples/mermaid/system-landscape-diagram.advanced.png)
            </figure>

## Definitions


???+ warning "About **labels** and **aliases**"

    `label` is a display name for the element.

    `alias` is a unique identifier used for referencing elements
    in relationships and layouts.
    If omitted, it is generated automatically.


    You can also use `label` for referencing elements in relationships     and layouts, but each `label` must be **unique** within the diagram.


<br/>

### RelationshipType

Relationship types supported by Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Items"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Type | Description |
    |---|---|
    | `BI_REL` | A bidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL` | A unidirectional relationship between two elements. |
    | `REL_BACK` | A unidirectional relationship pointing backward. |
    | `REL_D` | A unidirectional downward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_DOWN`. |
    | `REL_DOWN` | A unidirectional downward relationship. |
    | `REL_L` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_LEFT`. |
    | `REL_LEFT` | A unidirectional leftward relationship. |
    | `REL_R` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_RIGHT`. |
    | `REL_RIGHT` | A unidirectional rightward relationship. |
    | `REL_U` | A unidirectional upward relationship. Shorthand for `REL_UP`. |
    | `REL_UP` | A unidirectional upward relationship. |

### DiagramElementPropertiesSchema

JSON schema for tabular diagram element properties.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `header` | <code>array[string]</code> | Header columns. Default: `["Property", "Value"]`. |
    | **`properties(required)`** | <code>array[array[string]]</code> | List of rows (each row is a list of string values). |
    | `show_header` | `boolean` | Whether to display the header row. Default: `true`. |

    | `alias` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Unique identifier for the element. If not provided, it is autogenerated from the label. |
    | `description` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional description text. |
    | **`label(required)`** | `string` | Display name for the element. |
    | `properties` | <code><a href="#diagramelementpropertiesschema">DiagramElementPropertiesSchema</a></code> | Optional property table metadata. |

## Mermaid Render Options


### MermaidRenderOptionsSchema

Final layout configuration for rendering a Mermaid C4 diagram.

Encapsulates layout directives, macros, tag definitions, and visual styles
applied at render time.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `styles` | <code>array[<code><a href="#mermaidelementstyleschema">MermaidElementStyleSchema</a></code>\|<code><a href="#mermaidrelstyleschema">MermaidRelStyleSchema</a></code>]</code> | List of style update macro configurations. |
    | `update_layout_config` | <code><a href="#updatelayoutconfigschema">UpdateLayoutConfigSchema</a></code> | Configuration for updating default layout behavior. |

### MermaidElementStyleSchema

Style update for an individual diagram element.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `ElementStyle`. |
    | `bg_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Background color. |
    | `border_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Border line color. |
    | **`element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the element to style. |
    | `font_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Font/text color. |

### MermaidRelStyleSchema

Style update for relationship lines.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Discriminator identifying the element type. Must be exactly `RelStyle`. |
    | **`from_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the source element to style. |
    | `line_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship line. |
    | `offset_x` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional horizontal offset for the label position. |
    | `offset_y` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Optional vertical offset for the label position. |
    | `text_color` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Color of the relationship label text. |
    | **`to_element(required)`** | `string` | Alias of the target element to style. |

### UpdateLayoutConfigSchema

Configuration for updating default layout behavior in
Mermaid C4 diagrams.

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | `c4_boundary_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of boundaries per row. |
    | `c4_shape_in_row` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`integer` \| `null`</span> | Maximum number of non-boundary elements (e.g. systems, containers, components) per row. |

# PlantUML ComponentDiagram Spec

Source: https://github.com/sidorov-as/c4-diagrams/blob/main/docs/converters/json/specs/plantuml.component_diagram.md

# PlantUML ComponentDiagram Spec

> **Source:** [plantuml.component-diagram.json](../../../assets/specs/plantuml.component-diagram.json)


This schema describes the [ComponentDiagram][c4.diagrams.component.ComponentDiagram] spec for the PlantUML backend.

## Properties

???+ info "Properties"

    <div class="code-nowrap"></div>

    | Field | Type | Description |
    |---|---|---|
    | **`type(required)`** | `string` | Type of the diagram. Must be exactly `ComponentDiagram`. |
    | `title` | <span style="white-space: nowrap;">`string` \| `null`</span> | Optional diagram title. |
    | `elements` | <code>array[<a href="#elements">Element</a>]</code> | Top-level elements. |
    | `boundaries` | <code>array[<a href="#boundaries">Boundary</a>]</code> | Top-level boundaries. |
    | `relationships` | <code>array[<a href="#plantumlrelationshipschema">PlantUMLRelationshipSchema</a>]</code> | Top-level relationships. |
    | `layouts` | <code>array[<a href="#layoutschema">LayoutSchema</a>]</code> | PlantUML relative layout constraints between elements. |
    | `render_options` | <code><a href="#plantumlrenderoptionsschema">PlantUMLRenderOptionsSchema</a></code> | PlantUML-specific render options. |
    | **`backend(required)`** | `string` | JSON schema backend. Must be exactly `plantuml`. |

??? abstract "Examples"

    === "Minimal"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/plantuml/component-diagram.minimal.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered PlantUML source"

            ```puml
            --8<-- "assets/examples/plantuml/component-diagram.minimal.puml"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![ComponentDiagram minimal example](../../../assets/examples/plantuml/component-diagram.minimal.png)
            </figure>


    === "Advanced"

        ??? example "JSON source"

            ```json
            --8<-- "assets/examples/json/plantuml/component-diagram.advanced.json"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered PlantUML source"

            ```puml
            --8<-- "assets/examples/plantuml/component-diagram.advanced.puml"
            ```

        ??? example "Rendered image"

            <figure markdown="span">
            ![ComponentDiagram advanced example](../../../assets/examples/plantuml/component-diagram.advanced.png)
            </figure>
